title: Isolated Subnet Provisioner with Smart Egress and Endpoint Lifecycle
creator: Aisha Carter
description:
Objective: Build a reusable Terraform module that provisions isolated application subnets with integrated smart egress (ephemeral NAT / shared NAT / IGW modes), per-subnet route table lifecycle, and VPC endpoint lifecycle management (S3, ECR, KMS, STS, Secrets Manager).

This module must be suitable for Redwood Private deployments (VPC and on-prem gateway patterns). Key design goals: idempotent Terraform behavior, predictable upgrade/rollout semantics for changes to NAT and endpoint topology, built-in proactive health checks, and clear observability hooks so Console can surface cost/latency per-route.

Scope / features:
- Inputs: subnet_cidrs, azs, subnet_roles (private/app/db), nat_mode (ephemeral | shared | dedicated), endpoint_list, route_table_tags, enable_flow_logs, kms_key_arn.
- Outputs: subnet_ids, route_table_ids, nat_gateway_ids (when applicable), endpoint_ids, cross-az-mapping, tagging map for Console cost attribution.
- Smart Egress:
  - Ephemeral NAT mode: create ephemeral NAT instances/gateways with autoscaling hints (min/max) and graceful replace behavior so active connections are drained before replacement.
  - Shared NAT mode: single NAT for low-cost dev tiers with explicit failover routing across AZs.
  - Dedicated NAT mode: per-subnet NAT gateway for highest isolation and throughput.
- Endpoint lifecycle:
  - Preserve endpoint integrity during upgrades: API supports endpoint replacement strategy = {none, sequential, canary}.
  - When replacing endpoints, update route tables incrementally and validate reachability before decommissioning old endpoint.
- Upgrades and safe rollouts:
  - Module surfaces terraform-friendly flags to enable canary applies (apply to a single AZ/subnet first) and run preflight validation hooks.
  - Preflight health checks include reachability (S3/ECR/KMS APIs), route table convergence, and a synthetic egress probe that exercises HTTP/HTTPS paths used by Redwood images and model caches.
  - Post-apply reconciliation tasks report drift and reconcile transient failures via a small operator Lambda (reconciliation disabled by default; opt-in via enable_reconciler).
- Observability and health checks:
  - CloudWatch metric names and log group prefixes configurable.
  - Synthetic probe implementation: Lambda running in one subnet that attempts GET/PUT to S3, ECR manifest fetch, and KMS encrypt/decrypt with test key; failures logged to a dedicated CloudWatch dashboard and a Console alert webhook.
  - Route table and NAT health: publish NAT EgressBytes and NATActiveConnections metrics; alert thresholds and runbook links included in module outputs.
- Security & compliance:
  - KMS integration for endpoint policies and flow logs + optional HSM-managed key ARN.
  - IAM least-privilege for the reconcilers and probes.

Non-goals: service-chaining (service mesh) and cross-account VPC peering orchestration (handled by separate module).
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module publishes documented inputs/outputs and passes unit plan tests against 3 AZs (private/shared/dedicated NAT modes)
Canary apply workflow exercises single-AZ subnet changes and validates preflight probes before rolling to remaining AZs
Synthetic probe Lambda runbook demonstrates detection of endpoint regression and triggers Console webhook when degraded
Upgrade sequence for endpoint replacement respects endpoint replacement strategy and leaves no transient blackhole for traffic
Module integrates with Console tagging schema and outputs cost attribution tags for subnets and NAT resources
comments: 2026-01-29 - Kickoff: scoping session with infra, runtime, and security. Agreed on 3 upgrade strategies (none/sequential/canary). Action: Aisha to draft TF interface and preflight checklist.

2026-02-05 - Design review notes: Security asks for KMS key injection and explicit IAM role for probe Lambda. Runtime requested endpoints include ECR + model cache S3 prefix. Linked design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFRA/Isolated+Subnet+Provisioner

2026-02-18 - Initial PR created: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1238. PR implements base subnet + route table + endpoint creation and adds unit tests for plan diffs. TODO: add ephemeral NAT autoscaling and probe Lambda.

2026-02-27 - Review feedback from runtime (Liyu Zhang): need per-subnet MTU/tag propagation for fast PFS mounts. Added tags input and propagation to ENI attachments. PR updated: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1238#discussion_r9981

2026-03-03 - Prototype of canary apply script in infra repo; uses terraform workspace pattern and a preflight automation that runs apply --target for first-subnet group then runs probe lambda. Script located at infra/ci/canary_apply.sh

2026-03-08 - Security completed threat model. Minor request: reconcilers must not auto-issue deletions for endpoints unless reconcilation_mode == 'repair' and an explicit operator confirmation tag exists. Documented in design doc.

2026-03-10 - QA: probe lambda failed intermittently against ECR in shared NAT mode due to ephemeral IP churn. Plan: add connection drain wait and retry logic; Luca to implement. Blocker: need test account with large NAT throughput to validate retries.
release_notes: Introduces a new terraform module for isolated subnet provisioning with smart egress options and endpoint lifecycle management. Adds observability hooks (synthetic probes) and canary upgrade orchestration. Admins must review KMS and IAM inputs before enabling reconcilers.
